name: io.github.karthikeyan5/sshgate
description: SSHGate MCP client half; reads free, writes need approval. Needs signer daemon + gate (INSTALL.md).
title: SSHGate

environmentVariables.name: SSHGATE_SIGNER_SOCK
environmentVariables.description: Unix socket of the local SSHGate signer daemon (default /run/sshgatesigner/sock). The MCP server dials it to get a human Telegram approval for writes; reads never touch it.
